items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: You talk about Branch Rickey. I'd say, "No, I'm not married. I'm not marrying nobody."

ctx.x: What time was your first marriage, when you finally met your wife - your first wife?

Milt, I wasn't going to marry nobody. It was impossible. But I ran into a situation in Omaha, Nebraska. Omaha, Nebraska gave me an education, for nearly Four years, from '30 up until the time I went to Kansas City. Everywhere I went and tried to get into a band, the band-leader would say, "Son, are you married?" You talk about Branch Rickey. I'd say, "No, I'm not married. I'm not marrying nobody." He'd say, "You have to be married to be in this band." So finally -
